article.headline: 49ers bolster receiving corps by acquiring Keenan Allen from the Colts
article.summary: The San Francisco 49ers acquired wide receiver Keenan Allen from the Indianapolis Colts in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round draft pick.
article.body: The trade marks a significant shift for the San Francisco roster as they add veteran depth to their wide receiver room. By sending only a late-round draft selection to Indianapolis, the 49ers secure the experienced pass-catcher without sacrificing premium capital. The deal comes as part of a series of roster adjustments for San Francisco as they push to improve their offensive production for the remainder of the season. For the Colts, the move clears a veteran contract off their books while securing additional draft assets for the 2027 cycle. The move was reported by Tom Pelissero of The Ringer, confirming the 49ers will bring Allen into their offensive rotation immediately. While the Colts remain committed to their core roster, including running back Jonathan Taylor, the departure of Allen highlights the team's willingness to rebalance their assets through trade. Fans and fantasy managers alike are now watching to see how quickly Allen can integrate into the 49ers' scheme during upcoming games. The receiver is expected to begin participating in team activities and practice sessions as he prepares to make his debut for San Francisco in the coming week.

article.headline: Hamilton rain washout forces Black Caps into desperate fight for series draw
article.summary: Heavy rain at Seddon Park abandoned the third ODI between New Zealand and India, leaving the hosts trailing 2-0 in the series.
article.body:
Not a single ball was bowled in Hamilton as persistent weather forced officials to abandon the third ODI of the series. The washout effectively ended New Zealand’s hopes of an ODI series victory against India, leaving the Black Caps unable to win the remaining two matches after already falling 2-0 behind following losses in Auckland and Wellington. The team now faces the prospect of their first home ODI series defeat since 2019.

This result is significant for the Black Caps, who have successfully defended their home turf by winning 11 consecutive ODI series over the last five years. For local fans who turned out for the sellout event, the abandonment denied any chance of a 40-overs-per-side contest. The loss of points and momentum comes at a difficult time as the squad prepares for upcoming test matches.

The challenge for New Zealand deepens as they enter games four and five without several key starters. Players including Tom Latham, Daryl Mitchell, Glenn Phillips, Henry Nicholls, and Nathan Smith are set to depart the ODI group to begin preparations for the test series in Wellington. Additionally, the side faces setbacks with players like Lockie Ferguson withdrawn due to injury, requiring a roster shuffle that brings in reinforcements like Finn Allen and Nick Kelly.

With only two games remaining, New Zealand must secure wins at Bay Oval to avoid a series loss. Both upcoming fixtures will test the depth of the squad as they look to salvage a 2-2 draw.

news.title: मौसम विभाग ने कल तमिलनाडु और अंडमान-निकोबार में भारी बारिश का अनुमान जताया
पहाड़ों पर बर्फबारी और दिल्ली में कोहरे के आसार, जानें देशभर के मौसम का हाल
news.og_title: पहाड़ों पर बर्फबारी और दिल्ली में कोहरे के आसार, जानें देशभर के मौसम का हाल
news.og_desc: देशभर में मौसम का मिजाज तेजी से बदल रहा है। दक्षिण भारत के तमिलनाडु, पुडुचेरी, कराईकल, आंध्र प्रदेश, केरल और अंडमान-निकोबार द्वीप समूह में भारी बारिश और तेज हवाओं की संभावना है। वहीं, पूर्वी और पूर्वोत्तर भारत के कई राज्यों में गरज-चमक के साथ बौछारें पड़ सकती हैं। नए वेस्टर्न डिस्टर्बेंस के सक्रिय होने से हिमालयी क्षेत्रों जैसे कि उत्तराखंड, जम्मू-कश्मीर और हिमाचल प्रदेश में बारिश के साथ-साथ ऊंचे पहाड़ी इलाकों में बर्फबारी के पूरे आसार हैं। दूसरी ओर, राष्ट्रीय राजधानी दिल्ली में सुबह के समय कोहरा छाया रहेगा और दोपहर में गर्मी के साथ-साथ वायु प्रदूषण की स्थिति बेहद खराब बनी रह सकती है। मौसम विभाग ने लोगों को सतर्क रहने की सलाह दी है।

news.og_title: ভাইফোঁটায় ঝেঁপে বৃষ্টি? কী বলছে হাওয়া অফিস?
news.og_desc: ভাইফোঁটায় কি তবে ঝেঁপে বৃষ্টি? কালীপুজোর সময় রাজ্যে হালকা শীতের আমেজ ও পারদ পতন অনুভূত হলেও তা নেহাতই সাময়িক বলে জানাচ্ছে হাওয়া অফিস। পুবালি বাতাসের জেরে আগামী মঙ্গলবার ও বুধবার রাজ্যে হালকা থেকে মাঝারি বৃষ্টির সম্ভাবনা রয়েছে, এমনকি উপকূলের জেলাগুলোতে বজ্রবিদ্যুৎ-সহ বৃষ্টিও হতে পারে। এর ফলে আগামী কয়েকদিন তাপমাত্রা ফের কিছুটা বাড়বে এবং শীতের এই আমেজ ফিরতে আরও বেশ কয়েকদিন সময় লাগবে।
